treatmentScope: Only Gaussian background on chaos-family segments changes by -3dB. Segments using recorded backgrounds retain original amplitude; every other waveform RNG draw, family selection and label is unchanged. Same seed, initialization, optimizer and short-gap mixture in both runs.
executionPolicy: RTX 3080 training, two 3,000-step runs only, each limited to 900 seconds. The cap tests one measured hypothesis with a matched control without extending the search after observing scores. ONNX exports and checkpoint evaluations run sequentially on Chonkus. An explicit wrapper sets PyTorch/ONNX/BLAS threads to 2 for baseline and all candidates; deployed runtime is unchanged. After GPU training finished, one independent two-thread acquisition replay was permitted concurrently, with at most four remote inference threads total. No further Mac inference was permitted after the thermal report.

import os,runpy,sys
for name in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS'):
 os.environ[name]='2'
import onnxruntime as ort
original=ort.InferenceSession
def limited(path,sess_options=None,*args,**kwargs):
 options=sess_options or ort.SessionOptions();options.intra_op_num_threads=2;options.inter_op_num_threads=1
 return original(path,options,*args,**kwargs)
ort.InferenceSession=limited
import torch
torch.set_num_threads(2);torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
script=sys.argv.pop(1);sys.path.insert(0,os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(script)))
runpy.run_path(script,run_name='__main__')

remoteBaselineParity: Every original standard-development prediction/error exactly matches the remote 2-thread baseline: 134/1,459 errors and 1 false character. Interrupted and consumed real aggregates also match.
selection: All standard-development checkpoints scored. A checkpoint failing primary relative/absolute improvement or any standard/noise guard is rejected early; its interrupted/real checks are not required. No final corpora used.

compatibility.result: Default offset0 equals prechange audio and labels bit for bit; generator/control validation and CWformer checks passed locally before thermal restriction and on Chonkus.

limitations: One paired training seed. This tests -3dB extra Gaussian chaos noise with all other settings fixed; it does not establish limits of other noise curricula or architectures.
